content.thinking: The issue: `simple_paths` uses `len(tail)` for the adjacency, but node count n may exceed len(tail) (n nodes, but tail list length is M). Fix: pass n.

arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import re
s = open('gen.py').read()
s = s.replace("def simple_paths(tail, head, src, dst, M, limit=40):", "def simple_paths(tail, head, n, src, dst, M, limit=40):")
s = s.replace("    adj = [[] for _ in range(len(tail))]", "    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]")
s = s.replace("paths = simple_paths(tail, head, src, dst, M, limit=60)", "paths = simple_paths(tail, head, n, src, dst, M, limit=60)")
open('gen.py','w').write(s)
PYEOF
cd /app/work && python3 run_tests.py 150 1
